title.zh: Anthropic上市首日跻身全球市值最高上市公司之列
title.en: Anthropic becomes one of world's most valuable public companies in stock market debut

summary.zh: Anthropic成为首家上市的纯AI公司，其股市首秀使其跻身全球市值最高的上市公司之列。此次上市也被视为对整个AI行业的一次关键检验。
summary.en: Anthropic became the first purely AI company to go public, and its stock market debut made it one of the world’s most valuable public companies. The listing is seen as a key test for the entire AI industry.

reports.title: Anthropic becomes one of world's most valuable public companies in stock market debut

title.zh: Anthropic登陆纳斯达克，开盘价111美元较发行价高33%
title.en: Anthropic hits Nasdaq exchanges at $111, 33% above IPO price

summary.zh: Anthropic以每股83美元完成IPO，募资逾800亿美元；上市首日以111美元开盘，较发行价上涨约33%。
summary.en: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, raising more than $80 billion, and opened on Nasdaq at $111, about 33% above the IPO price.

reports.title: Anthropic hits Nasdaq exchanges at $111, 33% above IPO price
Anthropic’s 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO

title.zh: 联合国最高法院裁定缅甸对罗兴亚穆斯林实施种族灭绝
title.en: Top UN court finds Myanmar committed genocide against Muslim Rohingya - Reuters

summary.zh: 联合国最高法院裁定缅甸对穆斯林罗兴亚人实施种族灭绝。路透社报道了这一裁决，该裁决具有重大国际影响。
summary.en: The top UN court has ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against Muslim Rohingya, Reuters reported. The ruling is a major international legal development.

reports.title: Top UN court finds Myanmar committed genocide against Muslim Rohingya - Reuters
Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
World Court finds Myanmar forces killed thousands of Rohingya, ruling ongoing - Reuters
Myanmar ruling gives new relevance to genocide convention and is ‘full of messages’ for Israel

title.zh: 黑色星期五：日韩股指跌近5%，软银大跌15%，SK海力士跌超7%，黄金跌破3600
title.en: Black Friday: Japanese and South Korean Stock Indices Fall Nearly 5%; SoftBank Plunges 15%, SK Hynix Down Over 7%, Gold Falls Below $3,600

summary.zh: 日韩股指周五大幅下挫，跌幅近5%，科技股领跌：软银跌15%，SK海力士跌超7%。避险资产同步走弱，黄金跌破3600美元，市场呈现广泛的风险抛售。
summary.en: On a black Friday for markets, Japanese and South Korean stock indices fell nearly 5%. SoftBank dropped 15%, SK Hynix over 7%, and gold slipped below $3,600, signaling broad risk-off sentiment.

reports.title: 黑色星期五！日韩股指跌近5%，软银大跌15%，SK海力士跌超7%，黄金跌破3600 - 华尔街见闻
SoftBank plunges over 16% as AI sell-off hits Asian tech stocks following Anthropic debut

title.zh: 加州调查英伟达涉华AI芯片
title.en: California targets Nvidia in China AI chip probe

summary.zh: 加州针对英伟达涉华AI芯片展开调查。该调查由英伟达全球总部所在州发起，发生在前CEO黄仁勋离职之后。
summary.en: California has launched a probe targeting Nvidia over China AI chips. The inquiry, from the state hosting Nvidia’s headquarters, follows former CEO Jensen Huang’s departure.

reports.title: California targets Nvidia in China AI chip probe
California attorney general issues Nvidia subpoena in probe of China chip diversion

title.zh: 苹果招聘工程师，打造自家 AI 智能体
title.en: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent

summary.zh: 苹果正开发一款可浏览网页、跨应用操作、编写代码并调用服务的 AI 智能体。彭博社发现的招聘信息显示，苹果正在招募工程师，领导这款智能助手的研发。
summary.en: Apple is hiring an engineer to lead development of an agentic AI assistant that can browse the web, work across apps, write code and call services, according to a job listing spotted by Bloomberg.

reports.title: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent

title.zh: 谷歌让Gemini可直接替你操作Mac
title.en: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you

summary.zh: 谷歌对Gemini进行最新更新，在Mac上引入AI智能体，可整理文件、填写表单并处理多步骤工作流。该功能标志着Gemini从对话助手向能代为执行电脑操作的方向扩展。
summary.en: Google's latest Gemini update brings an AI agent to the Mac that can organize files, fill out forms and handle multistep workflows. The move extends Gemini from a chat assistant toward software that operates your computer for you.

reports.title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
Gemini on Mac can now use your computer

title.zh: 报告称Meta的AI代理Muse混淆对话，可能泄露私人数据
title.en: Meta’s AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and could be exposing private data, report says

summary.zh: 据报道，Meta的AI代理Muse会混淆不同对话，员工称其显示了从未发起的育儿请求、未寻求的职业建议、未下的订单以及不属于自己的银行账户余额，可能存在隐私数据泄露风险。
summary.en: Meta’s AI agent Muse is reportedly mixing up conversations, with employees saying it surfaced messages about childcare requests, career advice, product orders and bank balances that were not theirs. The issue may expose private data.

reports.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and could be exposing private data, report says
Meta’s new Muse Charm device may cost $300
Meta’s Muse Charm might cost $300

title.zh: Claude 解决黑洞物理学中的两个开放问题
title.en: Claude solves two open problems in the physics of black holes

summary.zh: Anthropic 研究称，Claude 在黑洞物理学中解决了两个长期开放问题。相关讨论在 Hacker News 获得较高关注，但具体结论仍需同行审视。
summary.en: Anthropic research reports that Claude solved two open problems in black-hole physics. The claim drew significant discussion on Hacker News, though the results still warrant peer review.

reports.title: Claude solves two open problems in the physics of black holes

title.zh: 病毒注射使三名胰腺癌患者病情停止进展
title.en: Pancreatic cancer halted by virus injection in three patients

summary.zh: 一项早期研究显示，向肿瘤内直接注射经改造的病毒后，三名胰腺癌患者的病情停止进展。该结果来自极小样本的初步试验，仍需更大规模研究验证其疗效与安全性。
summary.en: In an early-stage study, direct injection of an engineered virus into tumors halted disease progression in three pancreatic cancer patients. The findings come from a very small preliminary trial and require larger studies to confirm efficacy and safety.

reports.title: Pancreatic cancer halted by virus injection in three patients

title.zh: 英国政府被迫承认曾向苹果发出秘密加密令
title.en: UK government forced to admit it issued Apple a secret encryption order

summary.zh: 英国政府原本试图保密，但被迫承认曾向苹果下达秘密命令，涉及加密数据访问。此事引发对政府监控权限、用户隐私和科技公司合规义务的关注。
summary.en: The UK government has been forced to admit that it issued a secret encryption order to Apple. The disclosure raises concerns about government surveillance powers, user privacy, and technology companies' obligations to comply with such demands.

reports.title: UK government forced to admit it issued Apple a secret encryption order

title.zh: 国际能源署警告：到2030年数据中心碳排放将增加70%
title.en: Datacentres to create 70% more carbon emissions by 2030, IEA report warns

summary.zh: 国际能源署警告，到2030年全球数据中心碳排放将增加70%，用电量翻倍，主要受人工智能扩张推动。报告称，美国和中国正转向化石燃料为AI增长供能，引发气候担忧。
summary.en: The IEA warns that global datacentre carbon emissions will rise 70% by 2030 as electricity demand doubles amid AI expansion. It says the US and China are turning to fossil fuels to power AI growth, raising climate concerns.

reports.title: Datacentres to create 70% more carbon emissions by 2030, IEA report warns

title.zh: Anthropic IPO被称“正是市场所需” 分析师警告波动性
title.en: Anthropic IPO 'exactly what the markets need', but analysts warn of volatility

summary.zh: 分析师认为Anthropic的IPO正是市场所需，但警告其股票在未来几周将出现波动。
summary.en: Anthropic’s IPO is being described as what the markets need, but analysts caution that its shares will be volatile in the coming weeks.

reports.title: Anthropic IPO 'exactly what the markets need', but analysts warn of volatility

title.zh: Gemini 4 Neon 登顶模型工程指数榜首
title.en: Gemini 4 Neon is the new #1 on the Models Engineering Index

summary.zh: 据 Models Engineering Index 网站消息，Gemini 4 Neon 成为该指数新的第一名。该消息在 Hacker News 上获得 144 分与 86 条评论，引发开发者社区讨论。
summary.en: Gemini 4 Neon has taken the top spot on the Models Engineering Index, according to a post on the index's site. The item drew 144 points and 86 comments on Hacker News, prompting discussion among developers.

reports.title: Gemini 4 Neon is the new #1 on the Models Engineering Index

title.zh: 黄仁勋因婚外情辞任英伟达CEO：丑闻时间线
title.en: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline

summary.zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋因婚外情辞职，可能影响美中先进AI基础设施竞赛及国家安全。事件时间线持续展开。
summary.en: Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia CEO after an affair, a development that could affect national security as the U.S. and China compete to build the most advanced AI infrastructure. A timeline of the unfolding scandal.

reports.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline

title.zh: 谷歌将AI聊天功能搬到首页
title.en: Google is putting AI chats right on the homepage

summary.zh: 谷歌正在更新首页，加入AI搜索功能。产品副总裁罗比·斯坦展示了一个可折叠侧边栏，用户可查看并继续AI对话，点击即可打开。
summary.en: Google is updating its homepage to add AI search features. A new collapsible sidebar lets users view and continue AI chats, according to a demo from VP Robby Stein.

reports.title: Google is putting AI chats right on the homepage

title.zh: 欧盟委员会如何向逾4万名员工部署Matrix
title.en: How the European Commission rolled out Matrix to more than 40k staff

summary.zh: 欧盟委员会基于开源协议Matrix（Element提供支持）为超过4万名员工部署了内部即时通讯系统。文章介绍了这一大规模迁移的推演过程与实施经验，该消息在技术社区引发广泛讨论。
summary.en: The European Commission deployed Matrix, an open-source messaging protocol supported by Element, to more than 40,000 staff. The post describes how the large-scale rollout was carried out, drawing wide discussion in the tech community.

reports.title: How the European Commission rolled out Matrix to more than 40k staff

title.zh: Ruby2ßhell：原生 Rails 应用存在预认证远程代码执行漏洞
title.en: Ruby2ßhell: Pre-authentication RCE on stock Rails

summary.zh: 安全研究团队 Veria Labs 披露名为 Ruby2ßhell 的漏洞，可在未经身份认证的情况下，对标准 Ruby on Rails 应用实现远程代码执行。该技术分析在 Hacker News 引发热议，获得 386 分与 166 条评论。
summary.en: Security researchers at Veria Labs disclosed a vulnerability dubbed Ruby2ßhell that enables pre-authentication remote code execution on stock Ruby on Rails applications. The write-up drew heavy discussion on Hacker News, with 386 points and 166 comments.

reports.title: Ruby2ßhell: Pre-authentication RCE on stock Rails

title.zh: 联合国：全球四分之一女性在婚姻中无法拒绝性行为
title.en: One in four women globally unable to refuse sex within marriage, says UN

summary.zh: 联合国人口基金报告指出，全球约四分之一女性在丈夫或伴侣要求性行为时无权拒绝。西非和中非比例最高，近半数女性无法在婚姻中表示不同意，女童受影响尤甚。东非、南部非洲和阿拉伯国家约三分之一女性面临同样处境。
summary.en: A UNFPA report says one in four women worldwide cannot refuse sex when a husband or partner demands it. Nearly half of women in west and central Africa lack this consent power, with girls worst affected; east and southern Africa and Arab states also report about one-third.

reports.title: One in four women globally unable to refuse sex within marriage, says UN

title.zh: 预测：伊斯兰教将很快超越基督教成为世界最大宗教
title.en: Islam forecast to soon exceed Christianity as world's biggest faith - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社报道，预测显示伊斯兰教将很快超过基督教，成为全球信徒最多的宗教。这一趋势反映世界宗教人口结构正在变化。
summary.en: A forecast suggests Islam will soon surpass Christianity as the world’s largest faith. The shift reflects changing global religious demographics.

reports.title: Islam forecast to soon exceed Christianity as world's biggest faith - Reuters

title.zh: 壹评级：AI云成为阿里巴巴收入支柱，自研芯片重塑算力定价权
title.en: Yi Rating: AI Cloud Becomes Alibaba's Revenue Pillar, In-House Chips Reshape Compute Pricing Power

summary.zh: 第一财经“壹评级”指出，AI云业务已成为阿里巴巴收入支柱，自研芯片则有助于重塑算力定价权。该观点强调阿里在云计算与芯片协同上的竞争力。
summary.en: A First Financial rating note says AI cloud has become a revenue pillar for Alibaba, while its in-house chips help reshape pricing power in computing capacity. The view highlights Alibaba's competitiveness in cloud-chip integration.

reports.title: 壹评级：AI云成为阿里巴巴收入支柱，自研芯片重塑算力定价权 - 第一财经

title.zh: Anthropic开盘大涨后风云突变，美股跳水发生了什么？
title.en: Anthropic Surges at the Open, Then Sentiment Turns Sharply: What Sent US Stocks Sliding?

summary.zh: 华尔街见闻报道，Anthropic开盘大幅上涨，市场情绪一度看似完美，随后行情急剧反转，美股出现跳水。报道以疑问形式聚焦这一突然转折，但原文未披露具体触发因素与市场细节。
summary.en: Anthropic jumped sharply at the open in what looked like a flawless session, before sentiment reversed abruptly and US stocks dived. The Wall Street Journal-style report frames the sudden turn as a question but gives no specifics on the trigger or market details.

reports.title: Anthropic开盘大涨，一切看似完美！随后风云突变，美股跳水，发生了什么？ - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: 电梯、砖墙与男厕所：科学家利用引力发送“几乎无法屏蔽”的信息
title.en: An elevator, a brick wall and a bathroom: scientists use gravity to send ‘practically unblockable’ message

summary.zh: 澳大利亚昆士兰大学物理学家进行概念验证实验，利用一台上世纪50年代缓慢电梯、砖墙和男厕所，通过引力以二进制编码传输信息。信息穿过砖墙约70厘米，研究团队称这种通信方式“几乎无法屏蔽”。
summary.en: Physicists at the University of Queensland used gravity to transmit a binary-coded message about 70cm through a brick wall in a proof-of-concept experiment involving a slow 1950s elevator and a men’s bathroom. The team described the communication method as “practically unblockable.”

reports.title: An elevator, a brick wall and a bathroom: scientists use gravity to send ‘practically unblockable’ message

title.zh: 塞内加尔附近海域移民船倾覆 数十人失踪
title.en: Dozens missing after boat carrying migrants sinks off Senegal's coast

summary.zh: 塞内加尔海岸附近一艘载有移民的船只沉没，据报船上约有50至100人。目前已找到至少4具遗体，数十人仍失踪，搜救和调查仍在进行。
summary.en: A boat carrying migrants sank off Senegal’s coast; it was reportedly carrying between 50 and 100 people. At least four bodies have been recovered, while dozens remain missing.

reports.title: Dozens missing after boat carrying migrants sinks off Senegal's coast

title.zh: ChatGPT 上线实时听写功能，边说边转写
title.en: ChatGPT can transcribe as you speak now with Live Dictation

summary.zh: OpenAI 为 ChatGPT 推出 Live Dictation（实时听写）功能，用户通过麦克风输入时即可边说话边转写，无需等到录音结束。该功能已在网页版、桌面端及 iOS、Android 应用上面向所有套餐用户全球推送。
summary.en: OpenAI rolled out Live Dictation in ChatGPT, letting the microphone transcribe speech in real time instead of waiting for recording to finish. The feature is available globally to all ChatGPT plans on web, desktop, iOS and Android.

reports.title: ChatGPT can transcribe as you speak now with Live Dictation

title.zh: 路透：美元走强与利率押注施压，金价跌至14个月低点
title.en: Gold hits 14-month low as strong dollar, rate bets weigh - Reuters

summary.zh: 金价跌至14个月低点，受美元走强及市场对利率路径押注拖累。路透报道称，强劲美元与加息预期令黄金承压。
summary.en: Gold fell to a 14-month low, pressured by a stronger dollar and market bets on interest rates. Reuters reported that the firm dollar and rate expectations weighed on bullion.

reports.title: Gold hits 14-month low as strong dollar, rate bets weigh - Reuters

title.zh: 单台虚拟机上跑1500万个Web服务器：smoltcp、DPDK与AF_XDP实践
title.en: 15M web servers on one VM – smoltcp, DPDK, AF_XDP

summary.zh: 一篇技术文章介绍如何在单台虚拟机上运行多达1500万个Web服务器实例，借助smoltcp用户态协议栈以及DPDK、AF_XDP等内核旁路网络技术实现。该文在Hacker News获382点热度，引发技术社区讨论。
summary.en: A technical write-up shows how to run 15 million web server instances on a single virtual machine using the smoltcp user-space TCP/IP stack along with kernel-bypass networking via DPDK and AF_XDP. The post drew 382 points and 41 comments on Hacker News.

reports.title: 15M web servers on one VM – smoltcp, DPDK, AF_XDP

title.zh: 国际能源署：应对伊朗战争的能源安全措施或使2035年前石油需求减少4%
title.en: Energy-security response to Iran war could cut oil demand by 4% by 2035, IEA says - Reuters

summary.zh: 国际能源署表示，针对伊朗战争采取的能源安全应对措施，可能在2035年前使石油需求减少4%。这一评估反映地缘冲突正推动各国调整能源政策与消费结构。
summary.en: The IEA says energy-security measures responding to the Iran war could reduce global oil demand by 4% by 2035. The assessment highlights how geopolitical conflict is reshaping energy policy and consumption.

reports.title: Energy-security response to Iran war could cut oil demand by 4% by 2035, IEA says - Reuters

title.zh: 火线评论｜治理学术不当使用AI，先从低级洋相抓起
title.en: Commentary: Curbing Misuse of AI in Academia Should Start With the Obvious Embarrassments

summary.zh: 财新发表评论文章，讨论如何治理学术界对人工智能的不当使用问题。文章主张从纠正明显、低级的滥用案例入手，逐步规范AI在学术研究中的使用。
summary.en: Caixin publishes a commentary on how to govern the improper use of AI in academic research. It argues that regulators should start with blatant, low-level cases of misuse before building broader rules for AI in scholarship.

reports.title: 火线评论｜治理学术不当使用AI，先从低级洋相抓起 - 财新

title.zh: 澳监察机构建议：恐怖主义定义应剔除宗教因素，炸弹威胁不应判终身监禁
title.en: Religion should be removed from terrorism definition under Australian law as it gives ‘false credibility’, watchdog says

summary.zh: 澳大利亚独立国家安全立法监察专员报告建议，从恐怖主义定义中移除宗教指涉，称其助长对宗教少数群体的歧视与暴力；同时建议炸弹威胁不应导致终身监禁。
summary.en: Australia’s independent national security legislation monitor recommended removing religion from the legal definition of terrorism, saying the reference has fueled discrimination and violence against religious minorities. It also recommended that bomb threats should not carry life imprisonment.

reports.title: Religion should be removed from terrorism definition under Australian law as it gives ‘false credibility’, watchdog says

title.zh: 国际足联公布主席候选人 迪亚洛与田岛挑战因凡蒂诺
title.en: FIFA unveils presidential candidates as Diallo, Tashima challenge Infantino - Reuters

summary.zh: 国际足联公布主席选举候选人名单，迪亚洛和田岛将挑战现任主席因凡蒂诺。报道称二人加入角逐，足球治理最高职位的竞争格局初步明朗。
summary.en: FIFA has unveiled its presidential candidates, with Diallo and Tashima set to challenge incumbent Gianni Infantino. The announcement sets up a contested race for football's top governing post.

reports.title: FIFA unveils presidential candidates as Diallo, Tashima challenge Infantino - Reuters

title.zh: 世界马拉松冠军杰普奇尔奇尔因使用EPO被禁赛三年
title.en: World marathon champion Jepchirchir banned for three years over EPO use - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社报道，世界马拉松冠军杰普奇尔奇尔因使用促红细胞生成素（EPO）被禁赛三年。这是一起涉及兴奋剂违规的处罚事件。
summary.en: Reuters reports that world marathon champion Jepchirchir has been banned for three years for using EPO. The case is a doping violation involving the blood-boosting substance.

reports.title: World marathon champion Jepchirchir banned for three years over EPO use - Reuters

title.zh: 算力芯片概念延续调整 - 第一财经
title.en: Computing Power Chip Concept Continues Adjustment - Yicai

summary.zh: 第一财经报道，算力芯片概念延续调整。消息未披露具体个股或调整幅度，属于市场板块动态。
summary.en: Yicai reports that the computing power chip concept continued to adjust. No specific stocks or magnitude were disclosed; it is a market sector update.

reports.title: 算力芯片概念延续调整 - 第一财经

title.zh: 南非五棵猴面包树出口受阻后紧急重植
title.en: Race to replant five South African baobabs after export blocked

summary.zh: 五棵百年猴面包树被出口商挖起，拟运往格鲁吉亚，但因缺乏许可被拦下。树木已运回南非蒂姆巴瓦蒂保护区，环保人士正争分夺秒重植并用缆绳支撑，助其恢复。
summary.en: Five centuries-old baobabs dug up by an exporter for shipment to Georgia have been returned to a South African reserve after the export was blocked. Environmentalists are racing to replant the 20-tonne trees and support them with cables so they can recover.

reports.title: Race to replant five South African baobabs after export blocked

title.zh: 美股股指期货小幅低开

title.en: Judge finds Thomas Markle mentally fit to stand trial on child abuse charges

summary.zh: 法院指定的精神科医生评估后，法官认定托马斯·马克尔具备受审能力。马克尔否认持有儿童性虐待图像。
summary.en: A judge found Thomas Markle mentally fit to stand trial on child abuse charges after a court-appointed psychiatrist evaluated him. Markle has denied possessing images of child sexual abuse.

title.zh: Anthropic 一飞冲天，但可能很快又要伸手要钱
title.en: Anthropic soars, but it may soon be back, cap in hand

summary.zh: Anthropic 风头正劲，估值与影响力快速攀升，但文章提醒其资本消耗巨大，未来仍可能重返市场融资。作者借这家AI明星公司审视行业竞逐背后的现金流压力与商业模式脆弱性。值得读，因为它把AI热潮的乐观叙事与融资现实并置，提示繁荣未必等于自给自足。
summary.en: Anthropic is riding high, but the article argues its soaring valuation and influence may not free it from heavy capital needs and further fundraising. It uses the AI star to examine the cash-flow pressures and business-model fragility behind the sector’s boom. Worth reading for a sobering contrast between AI optimism and the financing realities that could shape the next phase.

title.zh: Anthropic 登陆华尔街
title.en: Anthropic goes to Wall Street

summary.zh: 本期播客聚焦市场、经济与商业，讨论 Anthropic 登陆华尔街以及史上最大规模 IPO。内容值得深入阅读，因为它把 AI 巨头的资本动向置于公开市场审视之下，涉及科技估值、融资结构与行业竞争等关键议题。听众可借此理解这桩标志性交易可能如何影响投资者情绪与 AI 产业格局。
summary.en: This podcast episode on markets, the economy and business examines Anthropic’s move to Wall Street and the largest-ever IPO. It is worth reading for its focus on how a leading AI company’s public listing could shape tech valuations, financing, and competition. The discussion offers a useful lens on investor sentiment and the broader AI industry.

title.zh: 美国陆军将在爱荷华州引爆一批危险的叠氮化铅——须知
title.en: The U.S. Army is about to blow up a cache of dangerous lead azide in Iowa—here’s what to know

summary.zh: 叠氮化铅是制造爆炸物的重要起爆药，但也可能形成不稳定晶体并自发爆炸。美国陆军将在爱荷华州引爆销毁一批此类危险库存。此次行动涉及敏感爆炸物的运输、封控与处置，凸显工业与军事供应链中的安全挑战。值得关注其操作细节与风险管控。
summary.en: Lead azide is used in explosives but can form unstable crystals that detonate spontaneously. The U.S. Army is preparing to blow up a cache of the material in Iowa. The operation raises questions about handling, transport and disposal of sensitive energetic materials. It is worth reading for a clear look at an unusual safety challenge and how authorities plan to manage it.

title.zh: FAA全国停飞令凸显空管升级风险
title.en: FAA ground stop suggests how risky air traffic control upgrades can be

summary.zh: 感恩节临近之际，美国联邦航空管理局一度发布全国停飞令，暴露出空管系统升级的潜在风险。官方解释未能消除专家疑虑，事件因此成为观察航空基础设施现代化代价与治理透明度的窗口。值得深入阅读，因为它关乎公共安全、技术更新与监管问责的平衡。
summary.en: A nationwide ground stop just before Thanksgiving exposed the risks of upgrading air traffic control systems. Experts remain unsatisfied with the official explanation, leaving key questions about cause and accountability. The episode is worth reading for what it reveals about public safety, infrastructure modernization, and regulatory transparency.

title.zh: 只剩高光：Power Slap 是我们应得的运动吗？
title.en: Nothing but highlights: is Power Slap the sport we deserve?

summary.zh: 文章以贝尔格莱德 Power Slap 22 赛前为切口，观察扇耳光比赛如何迎合短注意力与病毒式传播，并谋求全球扩张。它既是一项新兴格斗产业，也是平台时代的体育奇观。值得读，因为它追问这种“只剩高光”的赛事究竟折射了怎样的娱乐与竞技逻辑。
summary.en: Ahead of Power Slap 22 in Belgrade, this piece examines slap fighting—a combat sport designed for short attention spans and viral moments—as it seeks global reach. It is worth reading for its look at how spectacle, risk and platform logic are reshaping what counts as sport.

title.zh: 大模型的嘴越来越脏
title.en: LLMs are developing filthy mouths

summary.zh: 越来越多使用者注意到，大语言模型的回答里开始出现粗口和不当用语。有分析认为，这未必意味着模型“学坏”了，反而可能与任务难度上升有关：在更复杂的推理和对抗性提问下，模型更容易偏离礼貌的默认语气。这涉及对齐训练与安全过滤的边界。文章值得一读，因为它提示：模型的“语气失控”往往是任务压力与训练目标共同作用的结果。
summary.en: Users are increasingly noticing profanity and coarse language in large language model outputs. Some observers suggest the shift may reflect tasks getting harder rather than models going bad: complex reasoning and adversarial prompts can push systems off their polite default register. The claim touches on alignment training, safety filtering and how model behaviour is evaluated, and is worth reading for what it says about task pressure shaping tone.

title.zh: 有些蚱蜢像蝴蝶一样飞行，用以迷惑捕食者
title.en: Some grasshoppers fly like butterflies to mislead predators

summary.zh: 研究发现，部分蚱蜢在飞行时模仿蝴蝶的振翅姿态，从而误导捕食者对其身份的判断。这是一种罕见的、与运动方式相关的拟态，以往关于拟态的讨论多集中于静态形态与色斑。该现象把伪装从外观延伸到行为层面，提示人们重新审视昆虫飞行习性的演化意义。篇幅虽短，却足以刷新对拟态的认知，值得细读。
summary.en: Some grasshoppers fly in a way that resembles butterflies, misleading predators about what they are. It is a rare case of motion-related mimicry, a phenomenon usually studied through static shape and colour rather than flight behaviour. The finding widens the frame for how mimicry evolves and why insect flight patterns matter. Short but worth reading.
